article_title: Fate Therapeutics Wins FDA Clearance for FT839, a Dual-CAR T-Cell Therapy for Autoimmune Disease

content_preview.title: Fate Therapeutics Wins FDA Clearance for FT839, a Dual-CAR T-Cell Therapy for Autoimmune Disease
content_preview.summary: FDA cleared the IND for FT839, an off-the-shelf CAR T-cell candidate co-targeting CD19 and CD38 across five autoimmune diseases without chemotherapy conditioning.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared the Investigational New Drug application for FT839, an off-the-shelf CAR T-cell candidate from Fate Therapeutics engineered to co-target the CD19 and CD38 immune markers, according to a [company announcement](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/09/3324792/24675/en/fate-therapeutics-receives-fda-clearance-of-investigational-new-drug-application-for-ft839-product-candidate.html). editor_notes.content_quality: Well-organized News piece (Overview / What We Know / What We Don't Know / Analysis format). 778 words, within the 400-1200 News range. The Analysis section correctly frames the chemotherapy-free design as the article's news hook without overstating clinical significance, and explicitly notes the therapy has not yet been tested in patients.
editor_notes.source_verification: All 3 sources read from local gzip snapshots in sources/2026-07/fate-therapeutics-wins-fda-clearance-for-ft839-a-dual-car-t-cell-therapy-for-autoimmune-disease/ and sha256-verified against manifest.json (source-0: 78f65a0e..., source-1: 593d446b..., source-2: ee905564... — all matched). source-0 (GlobeNewswire, the original company press release) confirms every specific claim in the article: the CD19/CD38 dual-CAR mechanism, the 13 targeted genetic edits, the Phase 1/2 basket trial design without conditioning chemotherapy, the five initial autoimmune indications (rheumatoid arthritis, ANCA-associated vasculitis, idiopathic inflammatory myositis, SLE with/without nephritis, systemic sclerosis), the Sword & Shield/Alloimmune Defense Receptor + CD58 knockout mechanism, the clonal master iPSC bank manufacturing approach, the FT819 comparison, the planned investigator-initiated T1D/MS trials, and both direct quotes from Bob Valamehr — both quotes verified verbatim against the snapshot text. source-1 (BioSpace) is a syndicated republication of the identical GlobeNewswire press release text, independently confirming the same claims via a second outlet as the article's inline citations claim. source-2 (StockTitan) independently corroborates the five-indication list and additionally confirms the article's stock-move claim: the snapshot's Argus market-data panel states 'FATE +6.14% in the Jul 9 session' and 'In the Jul 9 session, FATE gained 6.14%,' matching the article's 'rose 6.14%' paraphrase exactly.
